questionText: Which ONE of the following languages is accepted by a deterministic pushdown automaton?
options: Any language accepted by a non-deterministic pushdown automaton.
explanation:
Step-by-step Explanation:

• Deterministic Pushdown Automata (DPDA): A DPDA accepts Deterministic Context-Free Languages (DCFLs).

• Hierarchy of Languages:
$$\text{Regular Languages} \subset \text{DCFLs} \subset \text{CFLs} \subset \text{Decidable Languages}$$

• Since every regular language is a DCFL, a DPDA can accept any regular language.

• A DPDA cannot accept all Context-Free Languages (CFLs) because non-deterministic CFLs (like $L = \{ w w^R \mid w \in \{a, b\}^* \}$) require a Non-deterministic Pushdown Automaton (NPDA).

Therefore, Option (A) is the correct answer.
